tasks.label: demo: simplify selected mesh (mingw+ninja release)
args: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $exe=Join-Path $root 'build\mingw-ninja-release\bin\linequadrics.exe'; $meshRel='${input:demoMesh}'; $mesh=Join-Path $root $meshRel; $ratio='${input:demoRatio}'; $preset='${input:demoPreset}'; $case=[IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($meshRel); $outDir=Join-Path $root ('examples\output\vscode_demo\'+$case+'\'+$preset+'_r'+($ratio -replace '\.','_')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null; $out=Join-Path $outDir 'simplified.stl'; $metrics=Join-Path $outDir 'metrics.csv'; $flags=@('simplify',$mesh,$out,'--ratio',$ratio,'--samples','${input:demoSamples}','--metrics-csv',$metrics); switch($preset){ 'standard-qem' { $flags += @('--method','standard') } 'line-qem' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3') } 'dihedral-line' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3','--weight-mode','dihedral','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','${input:demoFeatureAngle}') } 'feature-curves' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3','--weight-mode','dihedral','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','${input:demoFeatureAngle}','--preserve-feature-curves','--feature-curve-weight','0.08','--max-feature-curve-deviation-ratio','0.05','--circle-fit-threshold','0.04','--ellipse-fit-threshold','0.05','--min-circular-feature-loop-vertices','12') } 'industrial-safe' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3','--weight-mode','dihedral','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','${input:demoFeatureAngle}','--preserve-feature-curves','--feature-curve-weight','0.08','--max-feature-curve-deviation-ratio','0.05','--max-local-error-ratio','0.02','--industrial-safe') } 'normal-tensor' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3','--weight-mode','normal-tensor','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','179','--normal-tensor-threshold','0.06','--normal-tensor-edge-alignment','0.2','--normal-tensor-scales','3') } } & $exe @flags; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host "Output: $outDir"

tasks.label: demo: feature report selected mesh
args: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $exe=Join-Path $root 'build\mingw-ninja-release\bin\linequadrics.exe'; $meshRel='${input:demoMesh}'; $mesh=Join-Path $root $meshRel; $case=[IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($meshRel); $outDir=Join-Path $root ('examples\output\vscode_demo\'+$case+'\feature_report'); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null; $csv=Join-Path $outDir 'features.csv'; & $exe feature-report $mesh --feature-angle-deg '${input:demoFeatureAngle}' --circle-fit-threshold 0.04 --ellipse-fit-threshold 0.05 --normal-tensor-threshold 0.06 --normal-tensor-edge-alignment 0.2 --csv $csv; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host "Feature CSV: $csv"

tasks.label: demo: ratio sweep selected mesh
args: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $exe=Join-Path $root 'build\mingw-ninja-release\bin\linequadrics.exe'; $meshRel='${input:demoMesh}'; $mesh=Join-Path $root $meshRel; $case=[IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($meshRel); $preset='${input:demoPreset}'; $outDir=Join-Path $root ('examples\output\vscode_demo\'+$case+'\ratio_sweep_'+$preset); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null; $flags=@('ratio-sweep',$mesh,$outDir,'--ratios','${input:demoRatios}','--samples','${input:demoSamples}'); if($preset -eq 'standard-qem'){ $flags += @('--method','standard') } else { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3') }; if($preset -eq 'dihedral-line' -or $preset -eq 'feature-curves' -or $preset -eq 'industrial-safe'){ $flags += @('--weight-mode','dihedral','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','${input:demoFeatureAngle}') }; if($preset -eq 'feature-curves' -or $preset -eq 'industrial-safe'){ $flags += @('--preserve-feature-curves','--feature-curve-weight','0.08','--max-feature-curve-deviation-ratio','0.05','--circle-fit-threshold','0.04','--ellipse-fit-threshold','0.05','--min-circular-feature-loop-vertices','12') }; if($preset -eq 'industrial-safe'){ $flags += @('--max-local-error-ratio','0.02','--industrial-safe') }; if($preset -eq 'normal-tensor'){ $flags += @('--weight-mode','normal-tensor','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','179','--normal-tensor-threshold','0.06','--normal-tensor-edge-alignment','0.2','--normal-tensor-scales','3') }; & $exe @flags; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host "Sweep output: $outDir"

tasks.label: demo: algorithm comparison selected mesh
args: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $exe=Join-Path $root 'build\mingw-ninja-release\bin\linequadrics.exe'; $meshRel='${input:demoMesh}'; $mesh=Join-Path $root $meshRel; $ratio='${input:demoRatio}'; $case=[IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($meshRel); $outDir=Join-Path $root ('examples\output\vscode_demo\'+$case+'\algorithm_compare_r'+($ratio -replace '\.','_')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null; $presets=@('standard-qem','line-qem','dihedral-line','feature-curves','normal-tensor'); foreach($preset in $presets){ $out=Join-Path $outDir ($preset+'.stl'); $metrics=Join-Path $outDir ($preset+'_metrics.csv'); $flags=@('simplify',$mesh,$out,'--ratio',$ratio,'--samples','${input:demoSamples}','--metrics-csv',$metrics); switch($preset){ 'standard-qem' { $flags += @('--method','standard') } 'line-qem' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3') } 'dihedral-line' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3','--weight-mode','dihedral','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','${input:demoFeatureAngle}') } 'feature-curves' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3','--weight-mode','dihedral','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','${input:demoFeatureAngle}','--preserve-feature-curves','--feature-curve-weight','0.08','--max-feature-curve-deviation-ratio','0.05','--circle-fit-threshold','0.04','--ellipse-fit-threshold','0.05','--min-circular-feature-loop-vertices','12') } 'normal-tensor' { $flags += @('--method','line','--line-weight','1e-3','--weight-mode','normal-tensor','--feature-boost','0.08','--feature-angle-deg','179','--normal-tensor-threshold','0.06','--normal-tensor-edge-alignment','0.2','--normal-tensor-scales','3') } }; Write-Host "=== $preset ==="; & $exe @flags; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; & $exe summarize-metrics $outDir (Join-Path $outDir 'summary.csv'); Write-Host "Comparison output: $outDir"
